title: Mind For Music
text: An analysis of how musical genres have evolved across the Billboard Hot 100, comparing all-time chart toppers against every year from 1958 to 2024. You can inspect the complete song-level data on the Explore the data page.

title: Mind For Music
section: How Technology Eras Transformed Music Genres (1958 – 2024)
text:
How Technology Eras Transformed Music Genres (1958 – 2024)
How did the transition from vinyl and transistor radios to MP3s, streaming, and social media alter what reached the top of the Billboard charts? Each bar below represents a defining era in music and tech distribution. Hover over each genre to explore its share of hits during that era.

title: Data Exploration
section: The Longevity Hall of Fame: Record-Breaking Staying Power
text:
The Longevity Hall of Fame: Record-Breaking Staying Power
Most hit songs remain on the Billboard Hot 100 for 15 to 20 weeks. A rare few capture the cultural zeitgeist and stay on the charts for almost an entire year or longer. The ranking below shows the longest-charting songs in Billboard history (45+ weeks). Hover or click any song to view its peak position and run.







💡 Click any record-breaking song bar above to pin its chart run details here.
